description: Presidential Secretariat - Appoint Hon. Balendren Sasi Mahendren Esquire Judge of the Count of Appeal as a member of the Special Presidential Commission
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the appointment of a Judge of the Court of Appeal as a Member of a Special Presidential Commission of Inquiry. This falls under judicial appointments and matters related to a commission of inquiry, which is classified under Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes (Type 9).
